# LinkGuard Platform
Fast, secure URL shortener with real-time analytics, privacy protection, and customizable QR code studio.

## Core APIs
- GET /{shortCode} - Resolves 302 Found redirect (<10ms memory lookup)
- POST /api/v1/urls - Creates short URL or custom slug
- GET /api/v1/urls - Fetches user short URLs
- GET /api/v1/analytics/{id} - Returns click analytics and distribution
- GET /api/v1/admin/users - Admin user directory search
- GET /api/v1/admin/urls - Global link moderation directory
